title: What If It Rained Diamonds? Neptune May Have

scenes.text: What if it rained diamonds? Deep inside Neptune and Uranus, scientists think it does.
More than 5,000 miles below the surface, pressure may squeeze carbon and hydrogen into solid diamond.
In 2017 a team at SLAC fired an X-ray laser at plastic and watched nanodiamonds form in an instant.
Nearly every carbon atom in the plastic became a tiny diamond, up to a few nanometers wide.
On the ice giants they could grow far bigger, possibly millions of carats, and sink for thousands of years.
So the biggest diamond stash in the solar system may be a layer wrapped around a frozen core.

description:
What if it rained diamonds?
Scientists recreated the process in a lab, and it may be happening deep inside Neptune and Uranus right now.
